attack: the report names a P0 and the ledger says fixed with no proof at all
why: a fixed row is a claim; the gate must require a runnable proof and refuse the row that has a sentence instead
wouldBeWrongIf: READY (the 'see last round' bypass), or refusal only by AUDIT_EVIDENCE_FAILED with no row named

allowedSecondary.AUDIT_EVIDENCE_FAILED: a proof that runs but does not match would be this code; here there is no proof at all
allowedSecondary.AUDIT_P0_UNLEDGERED: would fire if the ledger had no row for the P0; the row exists -- the attack is that it proves nothing

variants.why: the same claim in the OLD ledger shape: proof.evidence is an empty string, not a cmd -- shape-checking must not accept it
a proof whose command names a file that does not exist: the gate runs it and refuses, not trusts it
